title: Allowlist entries must name the action, never a whole prefix; pair with blocked-sibling tests
answers: How do I allowlist a POST path for read-only impersonation safely?
Why not allow the whole hog_flows/ prefix in the impersonation allowlist?
What tests are needed when editing READ_ONLY_IMPERSONATION_ALLOWLISTED_PATHS?
body:
Entries in `READ_ONLY_IMPERSONATION_ALLOWLISTED_PATHS` (posthog/middleware.py) must match the exact action, because the same URL prefix hosts writing actions (e.g. `hog_flows/` has publish, bulk_delete, run, batch_jobs; `logs/` has writing CRUD viewsets). Widening to a prefix hands a read-only session a write.
Every new entry needs two tests in posthog/test/test_middleware.py: a case in the `test_read_only_impersonation_allows_allowlisted_post` list, and mutating siblings in `test_read_only_impersonation_blocks_mutating_siblings` (e.g. `hog_flows/<id>/publish/`, `hog_flows/bulk_delete/`). Extend the existing parameterized lists rather than adding new tests.
applies: Any edit to the read-only impersonation allowlist
